light file: the favicon's prefers-color-scheme:dark rule #ffffff -> #201c1d, so the light file stays Off-Black whatever the OS theme

notes: DECISION: Stack Exchange has dropped its blue speech-bubble logo: stackexchange.com now uses Stack Overflow's 2025 'stack' symbol (its topbar logo and favicon), and calls the network 'Stack Overflow communities'. The current NoClick icon (cdn.sstatic.net/stackexchange/Img/apple-touch-icon.png) is the retired logo. The favicon decides its colour with a prefers-color-scheme rule; each file now pins one colour (light #201c1d, dark #FFFFFF) because NoClick's theme isn't the OS's.
